name: General Marcus Jonathan
summary: General Marcus Jonathan is the High Commander of Stormwind Defense, stationed directly at the gates in the Valley of Heroes. A veteran of the Second War, he oversees the garrison protecting the capital and manages military requests from the kingdom's frontier settlements.

sections.title: Commander of the Gates
sections.body: Mounted atop his steed in the Valley of Heroes, General Marcus Jonathan stands as the first line of defense and the highest-ranking military officer overseeing the city gates. He fought in the Second War alongside renowned soldiers like Reginald Windsor under the command of General Turalyon. In this era of rising tension, Jonathan must balance the immediate security of the capital with the increasingly desperate calls for aid from frontier towns like Lakeshire.

sections.title: A Strained Command
sections.body: While towns like Lakeshire beg for Stormwind soldiers to repel Blackrock orcs and gnolls, Jonathan assures local magistrates of his commitment to help, yet he privately confides that the court has grown distant and the boy-king's regency behaves strangely.

faq.q: Where can I find General Marcus Jonathan?
faq.answer: He is stationed on horseback right inside the main gates of Stormwind City, overlooking the entrance bridge in the Valley of Heroes.

faq.q: What is Marcus Jonathan's military history?
aliases: did marcus fight in the second war
faq.answer: Marcus Jonathan is a veteran who served under General Turalyon during the Second War. He fought alongside comrades such as Reginald Windsor before eventually rising to become the High Commander of Stormwind Defense.

faq.q: What is the coin in the Dalaran fountain about?
faq.answer: As a young private visiting Dalaran, Marcus Jonathan tossed a copper coin into the fountain wishing that he would grow a glorious, bushy mustache someday—a wish his prominent facial hair confirms came true.

angles.text: Marcus Jonathan embodies Stormwind's martial pride at the capital's gate.
As the supreme commander of Stormwind's gates and a Second War veteran, Jonathan represents the pinnacle of standard martial duty within the kingdom's infantry ranks.
